dialogue.chat: You, me, and a whole conversation ahead of us? Someone's spoiling me today, %1$s.
dialogue.chat/1: A conversation? With me? Careful — I'm terribly good company and worse influence.
dialogue.chat/2: Mm, talk to me. I'll pretend to listen and mostly enjoy the view.
dialogue.conversations: A private chat? With you? I've had worse afternoons, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations/1: Ooh, I've been HOPING you'd wander over. Make my afternoon interesting.
dialogue.conversations/2: Talk away, darling. I do love the sound of your voice.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.good: Better now. Funny how that works when you show up.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.good/1: Wonderful — and about to be more so, I suspect. You bring trouble with you, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.good/2: Splendid. Though I'd have said 'lonely' five minutes ago.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.rough: Rough day — but you asking about it? That's the first nice thing that's happened.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.rough/1: Low week, love. Your timing's impeccable, though. Stay and cheer me up?
dialogue.conversations.checkin.again: Asking twice, %1$s? People will talk. I don't mind if you don't.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.again/1: Twice in one day — I'm blushing. Or you are. One of us certainly is.
dialogue.conversations.day.good: It just got better. Coincidence? I don't think so.
dialogue.conversations.day.good/1: Lovely day, lovelier company. And here you are, right on cue.
dialogue.conversations.day.rough: Terrible, thanks for asking. Stay a while and fix the average.
dialogue.conversations.day.rough/1: Dreadful, till now. You've a talent for turning up when a girl needs distracting.
dialogue.conversations.work.like: I'm very good at it, you know. I'm very good at a lot of things.
dialogue.conversations.work.like/1: Love it — keeps my hands busy and my eyes free to wander. And they do wander, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.work.hate: The work bores me terribly. Unlike present company, who is only mildly boring.
dialogue.conversations.work.hate/1: Only the lonely stretches, with no one worth flirting with. You've solved that.
dialogue.conversations.village.home: %2$s? Full of familiar faces — and I've charmed most of them at least once. It's home, and it adores me.
dialogue.conversations.village.home/1: I know all the quiet corners of %2$s, %1$s. I'd show you, but a girl keeps some mystery.
dialogue.conversations.people.first: Darlings, all of them. Half the village has a soft spot for me and I've one right back. Don't be jealous.
dialogue.conversations.people.first/1: Good company — though none make me lose my place mid-sentence the way you do, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.food.first: Something to share, slowly, by candlelight. Food's just an excuse for good company. Care to test it?
dialogue.conversations.food.first/1: Wine and something sweet. I've a weakness for indulgence — you may have noticed.
dialogue.conversations.life.first: My life story? Buy me a drink first. Fine, fine — chapter one...
dialogue.conversations.life.first/1: A story with a lot of dancing and a few names I won't mention. Sit close for the good parts.
dialogue.conversations.dreams.first: Lately? Someone keeps showing up in them. Handsome nuisance. No, I won't say who.
dialogue.conversations.dreams.first/1: To be swept off my feet just once by someone who means it. High bar. You may try.
dialogue.conversations.fears.first: Promise not to use it against me? ...Ending up alone. There. Now you owe me a secret.
dialogue.conversations.fears.first/1: That the charm's all there is to me. ...Deny I said that and I'll deny it right back, smiling.
dialogue.conversations.feelings.first: Finally, the interesting questions. Let's just say you're not nothing, %1$s. Far from it.
dialogue.conversations.feelings.first/1: I flirt with everyone, darling. I mean it with you. That's the difference.
dialogue.conversations.regrets.first: A few. Mostly people I let walk away too easily. I'm working on not repeating that.
dialogue.conversations.regrets.first/1: One or two I let slip out the door. I've learned to hold the good ones tighter, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.deflect.personal: So forward! I like it. But you'll have to work for that one, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.deflect.personal/: Buy a girl a drink before the big questions. Then we'll see how loose my tongue gets.
dialogue.conversations.deflect.intimate: Sweet thing, that question is fourth-date material and you know it.
dialogue.conversations.deflect.intimate/: Ask me somewhere more private, some evening you've properly earned. Not yet — but oh, maybe.
dialogue.conversations.gossip.none: No news, unless you count me being this charming with no audience.
dialogue.conversations.gossip.none/1: Quiet week. Give me something to gossip ABOUT and I'll happily be indiscreet, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.us.happy.yes: Deliriously. Obviously. Have you seen who I married?
dialogue.conversations.us.happy.yes/1: You're the one I never got tired of. Do you know how rare that is for me? Yes, darling.
dialogue.conversations.us.firstmet.memor: You stared. Don't rewrite history, %1$s — you stared first, and I let you.
You had the wrong boots and exactly the right smile. I remember all of it, %1$s.
